hypothesised_pattern: The target is about 0.63-0.78 when |x4| >= 0.96 (either sign) and about 0.17-0.37 when |x4| <= 0.56, and within the low group it climbs with x1.
rationale: Rows with x4 = -1.19, 0.96, -1.39, 1.75 have targets of 0.63-0.78, while the six rows with |x4| <= 0.56 have targets of 0.17-0.37.
